facts: Combined total raised across 100 fintech companies is £622.3m.
Nevis ranks first with £30.3m total raised.
The lowest value in the ranking is £2m (Ledger Rocket).
First place is 15.2 times the value of last place.
The top 10 hold 33% of the combined total (£205.4m).
Where they are based. London: 78 (78%), £504.6m combined; North West: 6 (6%), £24.6m combined; South West: 5 (5%), £49.9m combined; East of England: 3 (3%), £17.1m combined.

Most common sectors. Data provision and analysis: 35 (35%), £227.5m combined; Wealth, asset and investment management: 27 (27%), £191m combined; Budgeting and financial management: 24 (24%), £145.2m combined; Payment processing: 24 (24%), £172.4m combined.

copy.title: Top 100 UK Seed-Stage Fintech Companies by Total Raised
copy.h1: Top 100 UK Seed-Stage Fintech Companies by Total Raised
copy.metaDescription: See the top 100 UK seed-stage fintech companies ranked by total raised, with where they are based, their main sectors and team sizes in one snapshot.
intro: This page ranks 100 UK seed-stage fintech companies by total raised. Nevis leads the ranking with £30.3m, followed by Januus.io with £27.9m.
Together the 100 companies have raised £622.3m. The median total raised is £4.1m, while the mean is £6.2m, so a small number of larger rounds lifts the average.

sections.heading: Where the top 100 UK seed-stage fintech companies are based
paragraphs: London is home to 78 of the 100 companies, holding £504.6m combined. The largest group outside London is in the North West, with 6 companies and £24.6m combined.
South West and East of England also appear in the dataset, with 5 and 3 companies respectively.

sections.heading: Main sectors among UK seed-stage fintech companies
paragraphs: Data provision and analysis is the largest sector group, with 35 companies and £227.5m combined. Wealth, asset and investment management follows with 27 companies.
Budgeting and financial management and payment processing each include 24 companies, with payment processing holding £172.4m combined.

sections.heading: Team sizes in the seed-stage fintech ranking
paragraphs: The largest group by headcount is companies with 10 to 24 employees, numbering 49 and holding £288.4m combined. Companies with 5 to 9 employees number 23.
Eleven companies have fewer than 5 employees, and 10 companies have 25 to 49 employees.

faq.question: Which UK seed-stage fintech company has raised the most?
faq.answer: Nevis ranks first with £30.3m total raised. Januus.io ranks second with £27.9m.

faq.question: How many UK seed-stage fintech companies have raised at least £10m?
faq.answer: 15 of the 100 companies have at least £10m in total raised. Five of them have at least £20m.

faq.question: What is the smallest total raised in the top 100 list?
faq.answer: The lowest value in the ranking is £2m, held by Ledger Rocket.
